cards.text:
Brain: 🛠️ THE EVAL HARNESS IS BROKEN AND ITS NUMBERS ARE INVALID.
In this invented example, scripts/eval-semantic.mjs cannot run the evaluation harness embedding checks. Its local embedding helper has no production query-prefix normalization. The synthetic harness keeps a separate implementation of pooling and batch selection, so its example rankings do not describe the production semantic-memory.mjs path. Before relying on this fictional limitation, check for a later repair milestone.

Brain: 🏁 EVAL HARNESS FIXED AND EXAMPLE CHECKS NOW RUN.
The fictional scripts/eval-semantic.mjs evaluation harness now runs its embedding checks through the production semantic-memory.mjs path. The harness imports the production helper for query-prefix normalization, pooling, and batch selection instead of maintaining another implementation. This is a synthetic repair record with no measured performance result.
🛠️ Reusable lesson for this example: evaluation harnesses should import the primitive they intend to measure.
